 "explanation": "The unit responds to wheeled road motor vehicles, seen whole from the side or at a three-quarter angle, across many vehicle types.",
 "evidence": "All 20 top images are complete road vehicles (station wagon, sedans, taxi, SUV, pickups, vans, minibuses, buses, fire trucks, ambulance, police cars), and the activations fall only gently from 10 to 8 with no clear split by vehicle type, though cars rank slightly highest. Even a printed van advertisement (#13) activates it strongly, which points to vehicle shape rather than scene context.",
 "missing_data": "Activations on lower-ranked images and on non-road vehicles (trains, boats, bicycles, aircraft) would show whether passenger cars form the core with buses and trucks as weaker extensions, or whether the unit covers all vehicles more broadly.",
